output.reason: The changelog line [ev-f7d3abb12e99] is vague, but the linked PR [ev-56e3b21bf0e2] says what changed. When an incoming request is gRPC or gRPC-Web, Traefik's request metrics now set the `protocol` label to `grpc` or `grpcweb` and fill the `code` label with the gRPC code (for example "Unauthenticated") instead of the HTTP status; its sample Prometheus metric shows this. So the subject is the metrics middleware's protocol and code labels, and the change is a change in metric labelling, not a new endpoint. Applicability can be written from this: metrics are enabled and the deployment serves gRPC or gRPC-Web traffic. The consequence is that queries, dashboards or alerts that rely on the old HTTP-status code values for that traffic will see different label values. The PR also edits docs/content/migration/v2-to-v3.md [ev-ee47bb3f9ef7], which supports treating this as a migration-relevant behaviour change, although that guide text is not shown.
